items.name: Vault 96
items.contents: My discovery of Vault 96 feels, despite my abhorrence of magical thinking, like predestination. A biological research facility, unoccupied, simply waiting for me to discover it. Everything in its place, its systems ready for my arrival.  Examination of the Vault's computer systems and other records found leads me to understand that previous residents introduced a virus into the mainframe in an attempt to end some kind of hostilities with it. This may explain the unsealed door and their untimely fates.  The mainframe requires some work to bring fully online, but any hostile programming it had has been eliminated by the virus they introduced. Too late to help them, perhaps, but sufficient to clear the path for me.

-Libby

items.name: Ward's Journal
items.contents: When I first got to Foundation, I hid my raider history. I was ashamed of the things I'd done. I was afraid I would be punished by my new community. Mostly I was afraid I deserved to be punished. Then I found an old copy of "Be Better Than Your Worst Self" by Dr. Bryce Jayhart. It changed my life.  First, I had to admit my worst self to everyone. I confessed my raider history. I thought for sure they'd exile me or lock me up. Instead they forgave me.  Second, I have to take a daily inventory of how I was better today than the worst I was yesterday. It's a meditation exercise.  Third, I have to repeat "I'm better than this" to myself everytime I get down or disappoint myself or others. I actually got it tattooed on my arm. Not where everyone can see it, but where I see it every day.  Every day is a struggle, but every day I work to make myself and Foundation a better place to live. I just wish I could sign up for his 29 part self-help workshop series. They would be worth the $999 each.

items.name: Welcome to the Rapidan Camp
items.contents:
Welcome to the Rapidan Camp,
On behalf of the President of the United States, we hope that you enjoy your stay as our special guest of honor.  You'll find the kitchen stocked with everything you may need during your stay, including your favorite tea brand in the loose variety. Just ask your allocated Mr Handy if you get peckish.  The President is expected to arrive around 4pm, and dinner is expected around 6pm. We have venison steak with port sauce and Victoria sponge cake for dessert.  In the meantime, feel free to explore the grounds and enjoy the beauty of Shenandoah National Park.

items.name: Welcome to the Wasteland
items.contents: Hey newcomers,  Welcome to Appalachia. Hell of a place, isn't it? There's a lot of danger and a lot of excitement waiting for you.  I got some help when I first stepped into this big, beautiful, irradiated world... I figure you deserve the same. So in that spirit, I built a little box for gift giving. A place for the haves to leave something for the have nots. If you see something you want, take it. If not, well... you'll survive.  Good luck out there.  Signed, Your Friendly Neighborhood Wastelander

items.contents: I ain't been feeling right lately. James and his bleeding heart ain't helping my noggin much.   All his yapping about Jewel... Had to convince the stubborn bastard to go after her, lest a pack of ferals or something gets to her first.   Fool was waiting for my sniffles to subside, so had to chase him off in the end. Bit of wasteland motivation, if you will. [pagebreak] Waiting on me before chasing after his girl. Dumbass.  Just need some rest to feel right again and Murry's keeping me hydrated. The goofy bot can do that much at least, though the water's pretty stale.   Wish I could get Murry to mix me up a special cocktail,  but I guess it's tangy water till I catch up with him James on the road up north.  [pagebreak] Just gonna catch some winks and I'll be right as rain. I'll set out after him tomorrow maybe.

items.name: Wild Child
items.contents: Anna,  If you decide to show your face in the Casino Quarter again, make sure you're wearing a mask. Words can't express the immeasurable disappointment your father and I cope with every day knowing you've sold yourself out to the Munis. I thought we raised you better than that! Where oh where did I go wrong...?  You could've had a nice life here. A bearable one, at least. Gotten married, settled down. Maybe there would've been some grandkids in that now dashed future... Dreams that will never come to fruition. But you gave that all away for a job that hardly pays you and will send you into an early grave. Foolishness!  What motivates you, I will never know. But I will warn you: Rumors here are vicious, and the Family doesn't take kindly to traitors. In short? Stop trying to visit us. Not even for our reputation's sake. For the sake of your own life.  Do you dispatch medics to cure broken hearts? God only knows I need it.  -Ma

items.contents: Wolf. Check-in #64.  Blacksheep has failed to report in. This was his final warning.  Bo-Peep is dead. Possibly related to Blacksheep.  I'll be conducting a removal today. items.name: Xander's Journal
items.contents: 05/22 I can't believe Mad Bill Barlow survived all this time. Even crazier, all the places across America to go, and he came back to this dump?   Guess he remembered the stash was here... Just like old times. Wonder why we were drawn to this place? Maybe it's fate.  [pagebreak] 06/13 Bill took charge and everyone started gettin' their shit together.   Says its survival of the fittest now and he's gonna fight for our place in Ohio under the Rust King.   Says as long as we do what he needs and pay tribute to the guy, we get to live how we want out here.  [pagebreak] 09/30 Captured some of those Feral Ghouls. Apparently the Rust King uses them in his arena sometimes, must be good playthings for the Deathclaws he likes to keep.   Been selling one or two on the side to some weirdos who live at the old diner down the way.   Don't care what they're doing with 'em long as we get our cut. Might take a trip to Highway Town later, take a load off.  [pagebreak] 10/02 Got attacked by a pack of ghouls moving down from Athens. Managed to kill 'em all, but they broke a bunch of our defenses, and we lost a couple guys.  Bill had us pulling all kind of things apart to try to get the barriers up again. What a pain.   If I didn't know better I'd say they attacked us to get the ones we captured back... Can those things even think?  [pagebreak] 10/04 They came outta nowhere! Radscorpions. Right from under our feet! Didn't think they could break through concrete like that.  We didn't stand a chance. Dunno what happened to everyone, saw a couple die after we scattered.  I got stung pretty bad, managed to lock myself in secure storage, but it's still trying to get me. The bigger they are, the weaker the poison... right?

items.name: Your Mission
items.contents: Delta, I'm making an adjustment to your usual patrol route. Rather than the typical loop around the perimeter, I'd like you to expand your radius to include the road nearby. We've cleaned up the debris in the immediate vicinity, and the station has been secure for the last few days, but reports from Alpha indicate increased traffic -- hostile or otherwise -- along that artery.  Between Scorched, raiders, cultists, and the odd robot, it should be a fertile training ground for some of our greener troops. I know that's not strictly in line with our core mission, but I feel quite strongly that we need an effective fighting force at Tango to tackle any unforeseen circumstances that may arise.  That said, this is still a patrol, not a search and destroy mission. Don't go out of your way and endanger yourselves looking for action. I expect to see you back at base safe and sound tomorrow morning, just with a little more experience under your belt.  Ad victoriam, Initiates.
